text:
The patient has irritable bowel syndrome, which involves the colon. Its sympathetic preganglionic neurons arise in the intermediolateral cell column of the spinal cord at T7-L2, and the lumbar splanchnic fibers (L1-L2) serve the hindgut. L3-L5 is not the sympathetic outflow, because the sympathetic outflow ends at L2.

CONFIDENCE: 82
